dct_description_sm: The diving and movement data set was developped to gather more information about the foraging habitat of the Eastern Arctic-Western Greenland (EA-WG) bowhead whales population. This bowhead whale population has been given the status of Special Concern by the Committee on the Status of Endangered Wildlife In Canada (COSEWIC) and they are still at risk of becoming threatened or endangered in the future because of the combination of particular biological characteristics and the ongoing environmental changes in the Arctic. Looking at their spatial movements and diving behaviour will help us understanding their habitat requirements.
dct_title_s: Diving and Movement Data of Bowhead whale (Balaena mysticetus) in the Eastern Arctic
